Step 1: Understand what the Tenth Amendment to the United States Constitution is. It is part of the Bill of Rights, ratified in 1791, which reserves powers not delegated to the federal government to the states or to the people.
Step 2: Identify what Pitman shorthand is. Pitman shorthand is a system of shorthand invented by Sir Isaac Pitman, which was first published in 1837.
Step 3: Compare the timelines. The Tenth Amendment was written and ratified in the late 18th century (1789–1791), which is decades before Pitman shorthand was invented (1837).
Step 4: Conclude whether the Tenth Amendment was written using Pitman shorthand. Since the invention predates the writing by nearly 50 years, it is chronologically and historically impossible.

Final answer: No
